description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot configuration component that performs a database startup connectivity probe. It logs the effective JDBC URL and username (with credentials masked) and executes a 'SELECT 1' query to verify database connectivity without aborting application startup.

classes.name: DbStartupConnectivityProbe
classes.description: Spring configuration class that provides a bean to perform a database connectivity check on startup.

methods.name: dbStartupProbe
methods.description: Creates an ApplicationRunner bean that logs database connection details and performs a 'SELECT 1' query to verify connectivity during application startup.

methods.name: maskJdbcUrl
methods.description: Static utility method to obscure user credentials in JDBC URLs for safe logging.
